cycle.label: Reporting period
cycle.note: Colorado's CPE reporting period runs January 1 of an even year to December 31 of the odd year. Licenses expire November 30 of the odd year.

requirements.label: Total CPE
requirements.note: 10 hours for every full quarter your certificate is active — 80 for a full reporting period.

requirements.label: Personal development
requirements.note: Maximum, not a target. No more than 20% of your CPE (16 of 80) can be personal development.

requirements.label: Colorado Rules & Regulations (CR&R)
requirements.note: Up to 2 CR&R hours count toward the 4 ethics hours. CR&R beyond 2 hours counts as Specialized Knowledge, not ethics (Board CPE page). We count courses with "Colorado" and "rules" or "ethics", or "CR&R", in the title.

requirements.label: Ethics
requirements.note: 4 hours of ethics; up to 2 of them can be Colorado Rules & Regulations (CR&R) — more CR&R doesn't count as ethics. Regulatory and behavioral ethics both count.

newLicensee.note: First period: 10 hours for each full calendar quarter after your certificate was issued

licenseDateHint: December 31 of an odd-numbered year (your license renews the November 30 before it). Example: 12/31/2027.
issueDateHint: If your certificate was issued during this period, you need 10 hours for each full calendar quarter after it.
limitsNotTracked: Teaching and publishing combined: max 50% (40 hours).
Internet courses: credit requires answering 75% of polling questions (shown on the certificate).
recordRetention: Keep CPE documentation for at least 5 years from the end of the year the CPE was completed.
toVerify: First period: full calendar quarters after the issue date; the 4 ethics hours aren't prorated.
CR&R matched by title ("Colorado"+"rules"/"ethics", "CR&R"); only 2 hours count as ethics, the rest as Specialized Knowledge.
